title: HEX GFX Diagnostics
message: PermissionHub and CyberTask guidance is controlled from GitHub Pages. No device report is uploaded automatically.

guidance.SHIZUKU_NOT_RUNNING: Start Shizuku, return to HEX GFX, then run Diagnostics again.
guidance.SHIZUKU_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Open Storage Permission, select Shizuku, and tap Grant Permission.
guidance.SHIZUKU_NOT_READY: Wait a few seconds after starting Shizuku, then run the check again.
guidance.GRANT_NOT_SAVED: Open Storage Permission and grant the Primary or Secondary folder again.
guidance.GRANT_INVALID: Remove the old folder selection and grant access again.
guidance.GRANT_NOT_PERSISTED: Android removed the saved permission. Open Storage Permission and grant it again.
guidance.GRANT_READ_MISSING: Grant both read and write access to the Mobile Legends files folder.
guidance.GRANT_WRITE_MISSING: Write access is missing. Re-select the folder and allow full access.
guidance.GRANT_NOT_READABLE: The stored folder can no longer be opened. Revoke it and select the folder again.
guidance.SAF_PERMISSION_MISSING: The selected folder grant is missing or expired. Grant folder access again.
guidance.SAF_WRONG_TREE: The selected folder is incorrect. Select Android/data/com.mobile.legends/files.
guidance.SAF_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: The Mobile Legends assets folder cannot be opened. Start the game once, then retry.
guidance.SAF_DIRECTORY_CREATE_FAILED: Android blocked creation of a required folder. Re-grant folder access or use Shizuku.
guidance.SAF_FILE_CREATE_FAILED: Android blocked creation of the skin file. Re-grant access or switch to Shizuku.
guidance.SAF_OUTPUT_OPEN_FAILED: Android denied the write stream. Re-grant the folder permission or use Shizuku.
guidance.SAF_WRITE_FAILED: Folder writing failed. Check the saved grant, free storage, and archive, then retry.
guidance.SHIZUKU_WRITE_FAILED: Shizuku could not write the file. Confirm the service and app permission, then retry.
guidance.ARCHIVE_NOT_FOUND: The downloaded ZIP is missing or empty. Check the link and internet connection.
guidance.EMPTY_ARCHIVE: The ZIP contains no usable skin files. Check the archive structure.
guidance.DIRECTORY_CREATE_FAILED: The destination directory could not be created. Check access and free storage.
guidance.DESTINATION_CREATE_FAILED: The destination is unavailable. Check PermissionHub or Shizuku access.
guidance.WRITE_FAILED: The file write failed. Check access, storage space, and the archive, then retry.
